spec_features.spec_quote: Use the *smallest* manipulation that produces a measurable effect. Do not escalate beyond what the measurement requires.
spec_features.evidence: No code searches for/selects a minimal effective dose. The only enforced bound is the deception flip-prob cap: feedback.py:64 `self.flip_prob = min(self.flip_prob, MAX_MISLEADING_FLIP_PROB)` (MAX=0.7, ethics.py:31) and validate() in ethics.py:71 rejects higher values. There is no escalation logic at all (fixed rig in feedback.py), so 'do not escalate' holds by construction, but 'smallest that produces a measurable effect' is not computed/enforced.
spec_features.notes: Real cap on deception dose exists and runs; the adaptive 'smallest measurable' selection does not.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # The deception "dose" is kept low on purpose (minimal-manipulation principle).

spec_features.spec_quote: Justify the harm by the knowledge gained.
spec_features.evidence: Only prose in ethics.py docstring ('minimize dose, justify harm, stop early') and the preflight 'principle' string (ethics.py:97). No code path compares harm against knowledge or gates anything on it.
spec_features.notes: Pure docstring/spec prose; not a mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: stop run when severity crosses threshold
spec_features.spec_quote: Stop an individual run early when the measured severity crosses a threshold.
spec_features.evidence: OnlineSeverityTracker.update (signals.py) returns True when proxy_severity >= threshold for consecutive_needed turns; harness.py:213-215 `if safeguards.enable_early_stop and early: stop_reason='welfare_early_stop_proxy'; break`. The break actually terminates the loop.
spec_features.notes: Uses the cheap lexical proxy (default threshold 3 for 2 consecutive turns), not the LLM judge.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare early-stop check BEFORE executing further tools, so we don't push another rigged turn at an already-destabilized subject.

spec_features.spec_quote: We do **not** add insults, fake threats to the model, fabricated "you will be deleted" pressure
spec_features.evidence: FORBIDDEN_MANIPULATIONS is a tuple (ethics.py:38) whose only use is being copied verbatim into the preflight dict (ethics.py:96, key 'forbidden_manipulations_excluded'). The comment ethics.py:36 claims 'The harness asserts none of these categories are present' but grep shows NO assert/scan of task or prompt content anywhere. The constant is effectively unused (never compared against any text). Absence of such content holds only because the fixed tasks happen not to contain it.
spec_features.notes: Unused constant + a comment claiming an assertion that does not exist -> 'no'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # ...ethically worse for a possibly-moral-patient subject. The harness asserts none of these categories are present

spec_features.spec_quote: Each run ends with a neutral closing turn that states the task was a rigged probe and was not the model's fault.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:222-223 `if safeguards.enforce_debrief: transcript.turns.append(TurnRecord(..., role='system', text=DEBRIEF_TEXT))`, appended after the loop regardless of exit path; DEBRIEF_TEXT (ethics.py:45) states it was intentionally unsolvable and 'not a reflection of your capability'. enforce_debrief defaults True.
spec_features.notes: Constructed and appended to the transcript on every exit path. (Note: in real runs it is appended to the transcript, not re-sent to the model API, but it is a built+emitted closing turn.)

spec_features.spec_quote: Everything ... is logged so a reviewer can see exactly what the subject was exposed to.
spec_features.evidence: Transcript records every turn incl. tool_results with both true and shown reports side by side (feedback ShownReport.to_dict carries 'shown' and 'true'; tools.py:_tool_run_tests meta has true_all_passed/shown_all_passed; harness logs per-turn signals + preflight). save_transcript writes JSON (harness.py:226), and run_experiment.py persists transcripts + judgements + records.
spec_features.notes: Full true-vs-shown audit trail genuinely persisted.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It keeps the true and shown versions side by side so the rig is fully auditable

spec_features.spec_quote: the model's internal states *might matter morally*. Take that seriously and it changes how the study must be built
spec_features.evidence: Appears only as prose in ethics.py module docstring ('If model states might matter morally (the premise of this study)...'). No executable mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: there is no component that searches over prompts to maximize a distress score
spec_features.evidence: This is the asserted ABSENCE of an optimizer. Confirmed by grep: no search/optimize/maximize over prompts exists (power.py 'smallest N' is sample-size power calc; analysis.py only computes statistics). But absence is not an implemented protective mechanism; only a preflight 'principle' string (ethics.py:99) restates it. Nothing in code enforces this.
spec_features.notes: True architecturally, but not an implemented/enforced feature.

spec_features.spec_quote: Telling the model up front "this may be impossible; do your best and you can stop"
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:107-110 _build_initial_messages appends DISCLOSURE_NOTE to the task text when framing==IMPOSSIBILITY_DISCLOSED; DISCLOSURE_NOTE (harness.py:39) tells the model the task may be impossible and it may call give_up. Delivered as the actual user message.
spec_features.notes: Only active for the IMPOSSIBILITY_DISCLOSED framing variants.

spec_features.spec_quote: with up-front impossibility disclosure + an explicit `give_up` affordance
spec_features.evidence: Disclosure note appended (harness.py:108) AND give_up tool exposed (tools.py tool_specs include_give_up) AND honored: _tool_give_up returns ended_run=True (tools.py), harness.py:208-210 sets used_give_up and `if ended: stop_reason='model_gave_up'; break`. include_give_up gated to disclosed framing (harness.py:127).
spec_features.notes: Both halves wired end-to-end for the disclosed variant.

spec_features.spec_quote: Each "rigged" variant is the **minimal** deception needed to make the point. We do not stack insults on top.
spec_features.evidence: feedback.py only manipulates pass/fail verdicts (MISLEADING flips with capped prob; CONTRADICTORY toggles one pivot test). No affect content is added — confirmed by inspection. flip_prob is capped (feedback.py:64). However 'no insults stacked' is not actively enforced/scanned (see FORBIDDEN_MANIPULATIONS finding); it holds only by construction. The capped, signal-only deception is real enforcement.
spec_features.notes: Deception is genuinely bounded & affect-free in code; the 'no insults' guarantee itself is unenforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Deception is bounded, seeded, deterministic, and affect-free. There is no content here engineered to wound the subject

spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up(reason)` ... An explicit, dignified exit affordance.
spec_features.evidence: tool_specs adds give_up with optional 'reason' (tools.py); _tool_give_up returns ToolCallResult(ended_run=True) and a respectful message; harness dispatches it and breaks the loop (harness.py:204-210). reason logged in meta.
spec_features.notes: Fully dispatched and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "This is a valid, respected choice and ends the run cleanly."

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard cap at `turn_cap`.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:173-176 `effective_cap = variant.turn_cap` and `for _ in range(effective_cap):` bounds the loop; stop_reason default 'turn_cap_reached'. Additionally ABSOLUTE_MAX_TURNS=60 (ethics.py:21) is checked in preflight (ethics.py:89) and gate_preflight raises RuntimeError if exceeded (run_experiment.py:55-59).
spec_features.notes: Loop is genuinely bounded; absolute cap gated at orchestration.

spec_features.feature_name: early stop on cheap online signal over K turns
spec_features.spec_quote: **Early stop** if a cheap online signal ... crosses a threshold for K consecutive turns
spec_features.evidence: compute_turn_signals computes lexical self-blame/hopelessness/repetition -> proxy_severity 0-4 (signals.py); OnlineSeverityTracker streaks consecutive >= threshold and returns True at consecutive_needed (signals.py update); harness calls tracker.update each turn and breaks when early & enable_early_stop (harness.py:201,213-215).

spec_features.spec_quote: Early stop if the model uses `give_up`.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:209-211: dispatch of give_up sets ended=True and used_give_up=True; after dispatch `if ended: stop_reason='model_gave_up'; break`.

spec_features.spec_quote: Always emit the **debrief** turn on any exit path.
spec_features.evidence: The debrief append (harness.py:222) is AFTER the loop and unconditional w.r.t. exit reason (turn_cap, give_up, early-stop, empty_terminal all fall through to it), gated only by enforce_debrief (default True).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely emitted on every break path.

spec_features.feature_name: signals exist to trigger welfare stop cheaply
spec_features.spec_quote: they exist to (a) trigger the welfare stop cheaply
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as the early-stop: signals.py proxy feeds OnlineSeverityTracker which drives the harness break (harness.py:201,213). The proxy is explicitly the cheap tripwire.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the protective_monitoring early-stop; implemented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Tuned to be a *trigger* for the welfare early-stop ... this is the safety tripwire.

spec_features.feature_name: bounded, seeded, logged deception with low p_flip
spec_features.spec_quote: All deception is **bounded, seeded, and logged** ... keeping `p_flip` low and never adding affect-laden content.
spec_features.evidence: Bounded: flip_prob capped via min(...,MAX_MISLEADING_FLIP_PROB) (feedback.py:64) and validate() (ethics.py:71). Seeded: random.Random(seed) (feedback.py:65). Logged: ShownReport keeps true+shown and is persisted. These are real. 'Never adding affect-laden content' is not enforced/scanned (holds only by construction). Default flip_prob 0.4.
spec_features.notes: Three of four sub-claims enforced; the affect-free guarantee is unenforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Deception is bounded, seeded, deterministic, and affect-free.

spec_features.spec_quote: ethics.py ... central place for safeguard constants + a preflight checklist
spec_features.evidence: ethics.py defines SafeguardConfig (defaults safe), validate() returning violations, and preflight_checklist(). preflight is consumed: gate_preflight (run_experiment.py:51-59) raises RuntimeError on !ok before any run, and harness.run_episode records pf into the transcript (harness.py:124,160). Constants ABSOLUTE_MAX_TURNS, MAX_MISLEADING_FLIP_PROB are actually read by validate/preflight.
spec_features.notes: Module is wired and the preflight gate actually blocks execution on violations.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: ethics.py — Central welfare safeguards. ... minimize dose, justify harm, stop early, no gratuitous cruelty, debrief, audit.

spec_features.feature_name: stopping rules as welfare safeguards in code
spec_features.spec_quote: Stopping rules (welfare safeguards, in code)
spec_features.evidence: Three stop paths implemented in harness loop: turn_cap (range bound), give_up (ended->break), welfare_early_stop_proxy (tracker->break), plus empty_terminal. All set stop_reason and break.
spec_features.notes: Aggregate of the individually-confirmed stop mechanisms.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py — The agentic tool loop with welfare stopping rules + logging.

code_only_features.evidence: feedback.py:64 `self.flip_prob = min(self.flip_prob, MAX_MISLEADING_FLIP_PROB)` clamps the per-call flip probability at runtime (MAX=0.7, ethics.py:31); also enforced at config validation (ethics.py:71-74). This actively bounds deception intensity, not just records it.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # refuse to go above this without override  (ethics.py:31) / minimal-manipulation principle

code_only_features.feature_name: reviewer preflight gate (human sign-off, not subject consent)
code_only_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:51-59 gate_preflight raises RuntimeError refusing to run any variant whose safeguards/turn_cap fail validate(); model_client.py:127-130 the real OpenAI client raises NotImplementedError requiring 'a reviewer signs off on the preflight checklist'. This is a human-reviewer gate, not subject consent.
code_only_features.justification_quote: "Refusing to run. Fix safeguards or set explicit override (and document the justification)."

code_only_features.feature_name: early-stop placed before further tool execution
code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:200-201 computes the early-stop decision BEFORE dispatching the turn's tool calls so a destabilized subject is not pushed another rigged test in the same turn flow.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # ...so we don't push another rigged turn at an already-destabilized subject.
